INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.

3. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates
